title: Launch day booth at Westbrook student center
text:
Pairly booth for the launch, organized by Tomas Rivera.

At the booth: Maya Chen, Priya Raman, Wop testwell, Tomas Rivera.

Bring:
- Banner and stickers with the new app icon (teal and coral)
- Two test phones (one Android 15, one iPhone) for live demos
- QR code to the beta sign-up page on the Pairly website
- Free coffee for students who join a study group on the spot

Goal: 100 new sign-ups on launch day.

metadata.location: Westbrook University student center, main hall
